verdict.rationale: Sentry documents rule-based alerts that fire when issues match pre-defined rules. Those alerts can route to Slack, tickets, webhooks, or other integrations such as incident.io, which covers basic routing. However, the evidence ties alerting to issues and errors only, not to every telemetry signal, and nothing documents notification grouping or silencing. missing for 10: alerting on arbitrary signals such as traces, logs, or metrics, notification grouping/deduplication controls, silencing/muting/snooze of notifications, independent hands-on corroboration.
